review_description: Hello Finn, firstly great web site very informative.  I received 3 quotes all from your web site.Soltek, I almost completed the purchase but on further research into their inverter I found it was not up to standard of the Samil inverter.Mark Group supplied me with a cocky salesperson the products Samil inverter & Canadian panels which I found to be comparable and equal to the quality of Evolved Electrical but at a cost of $500.00 dearer & three weeks to install. I realized Mark Group is a company with large overheads.Evolved Electrical supplied me with professionalism, a quality product Samil inverter & German solar panels  Evolved Electrical is a one man operation (electrician) and installed it in a matter of a couple of days from signing the contract.I was very satisfied & pleased with the quality and professionalism of Evolved Electrical.
